notes: The Menu moved to Questions and now gates the games — answer 'Not for me' and that theme stops being dealt in Truth or Dare and Kindling. Questions get three buttons: Pass puts it back, Next deals another, Done ends. Scale cards label both ends so 1 and 5 mean something. The vague 'who decides' style questions are rewritten. Connection now asks about the last week and how you feel now, not twenty years ago.
